top_signals.title: Oil to Remain at $100 Per Barrel Through 2027, Oil Analyst Sankey Warns
top_signals.summary: Paul Sankey, president at Sankey Research, explains the factors that will keep crude above $100 per barrel for the year ahead and how that could impact diesel prices. Sankey also offers his outlook for European energy supplies, saying, “it’s gonna be an expensive winter for the average European.” He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: U.S. LNG Exports Near Record High as Europe Scrambles for Winter Supply
top_signals.summary: Exports of liquefied natural gas from the United States hit their second-highest level in history thanks to an uptick in demand from Europe ahead of the start of the winter season, which drove LNG prices higher. According to LSEG data cited by Reuters, U.S. exports of liquefied gas to Europe rose by 1 million tons last month, to a total of 6.89 million tons.
